name: 카엘룸
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Redesign the provided game hero's COSTUME, HAIR and silhouette as described below while retaining their original human/elf species, class, heroic personality and premium Korean fantasy anime PAINTED original-art finish. Output a perfectly SQUARE 2x2 sprite sheet on GENUINE alpha transparency: exactly FOUR full-body poses of the same redesigned hero, one per quadrant: top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left strike/casting, bottom-right walking. All four exact same body size, costume, hair and camera angle, orthographic 3/4 facing screen-right. EVERYTHING including weapons remains strictly inside its own quadrant, large 60px transparent gutters along every edge at 1024 size; full figure plus weapon uses ONLY 65% of quadrant height/width. Nothing touches the canvas edge or central divisions. No labels, letters, floor, background, shadow or box borders. Fine luminous material painting, sharply detailed ornament, expressive face, distinct silhouette readable at small game size; no photorealism/plastic. DESIGN: Human sun-sword knight. Give him a very distinct solar-duelist silhouette: swept copper-red hair, same youthful heroic male face and blue eyes, asymmetrical ivory and copper-bronze fitted armor, sunburst medallion, short burnt-orange shoulder mantle and white hanging sash, powerful broad flame-shaped greatsword held diagonally LOW entirely inside the cell, restrained amber edge light. No blue cloth and no shield. Heroic radiant champion, not corrupted.
edit_prompt: Edit the supplied redesigned hero sprite sheet. Keep the EXACT character, beautiful painted anime rendering, face, costume, hair and four poses. Make it a clean production SQUARE 2x2 atlas with HUGE transparent gutters: uniformly reduce each complete pose WITH its weapon to 55% of its quadrant dimensions, then place it centered in its own quadrant. No body, spear, sword, cape, staff, hair, glow or sparkle may cross quadrant divisions or touch canvas borders. At 1024 resolution, leave at least 60 pixels transparent on all four sides of EVERY quadrant. Feet matching local baseline in all quadrants, exact same body size. Keep idle top-left, anticipation top-right, attack bottom-left and walk bottom-right. REMOVE all floating spell halos, spell circles, sparks and separate FX painted into the art; retain the weapon itself and fine material edge highlights. No text, no extra hero, no shadow, no floor. Preserve actual transparent alpha and details.
extra_edit_prompt: CRITICAL SPRITE ATLAS LAYOUT REPAIR. Preserve this EXACT copper-haired solar knight design and painterly finish. Place FOUR SMALL full-body knight poses on a MUCH LARGER EMPTY transparent square canvas in a 2x2 grid. The four figures must look like SMALL ICONS surrounded by vast empty alpha space. EACH COMPLETE figure INCLUDING sword occupies ONLY 40% of its quadrant HEIGHT and 40% of its WIDTH. At 1024 output the entire figure+weapon must fit inside a 205x205px box at the exact CENTER of each 512x512px quadrant. Leave all central division lines and outer edges completely blank transparent, at least 100px clear on every side of each quadrant. No flames, no sparks, no aura or separate particles. The greatsword is solid carved bronze-orange flame-shaped metal, not a fire effect, short enough to fit its 205px character box. Retain four poses: idle, anticipation, low horizontal slash, walking, all equal character scale, whole feet and weapons visible. ACTUAL alpha transparency, no labels, no shadows, no background. Treat this as packing four small inventory figures into a large atlas, NOT a full canvas poster.
